territorial_scope.description: State-level program for businesses with qualified business facilities in New Jersey, administered by the New Jersey Economic Development Authority.

evidence.quote: The Next New Jersey Program is hereby established as a program under the jurisdiction of the New Jersey Economic Development Authority.

summary.short: Creates the Next New Jersey Program under the New Jersey Economic Development Authority, offering tax credits to businesses primarily engaged in artificial intelligence or large-scale AI data centers that meet investment and job thresholds, for applications before March 1, 2029.
summary.long: Establishes the Next New Jersey Program under the New Jersey Economic Development Authority, which may award tax credits to businesses primarily engaged in artificial intelligence or large-scale AI data center activities. Applications are accepted before March 1, 2029, and require at least $100,000,000 in capital investment at a qualified business facility, at least 100 new full-time jobs, a collaboration with New Jersey research universities or technology startups, minimum environmental standards, and prevailing wages for construction work. The Authority board approves projects; the business signs a project agreement with recapture, reporting and annual certification duties. Credits equal the lesser of 0.1 percent of capital investment times new jobs, 25 percent of capital investment, or $250,000,000, usable over the eligibility period, carried forward ten years, or sold as transfer certificates at no less than 85 percent of value. Section 98 of P.L.2020, c.156 is amended to add the program to an $11.5 billion overall cap and to allot up to $500,000,000 of Aspire and Emerge credits to it from fiscal year 2025. The authority's chief executive officer may adopt rules immediately, effective up to 365 days. Effective immediately upon approval on July 25, 2024.

enforcement.max_penalty_text: Forfeiture of all tax credits awarded under the program, in addition to any other criminal or civil penalties
enforcement.penalty_formula: Forfeiture of all tax credits awarded under the program

evidence.quote: the eligible business shall forfeit all tax credits awarded under the program, which shall be in addition to any other criminal or civil penalties to which the business and the officer may be subject.

enforcement.authority: New Jersey Economic Development Authority (the authority)
enforcement.triggered_by: Failure to submit the annual payroll report or the quarterly wage report during the eligibility period
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Forfeiture of the award for that year
enforcement.penalty_formula: Forfeiture of the tax credit award for the year concerned

evidence.quote: shall result in the forfeiture of the award for that year.

enforcement.authority: New Jersey Economic Development Authority (the authority)
enforcement.triggered_by: Number of new employees in eligible positions, or their salaries, drops below 80 percent of the number specified in the project agreement or required for eligibility, whichever is greater
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Forfeiture of the tax credit amount for that tax period and each subsequent tax period
enforcement.penalty_formula: Forfeiture of the tax credit amount for the affected tax period and each subsequent tax period
enforcement.cure_period: Forfeiture continues until the first tax period for which restoration to 80 percent is documented and approved by the authority

evidence.quote: then the eligible business shall forfeit its tax credit amount for that tax period and each subsequent tax period

enforcement.authority: New Jersey Economic Development Authority (the authority)
enforcement.triggered_by: Documentation for a tax period remains uncertified as of the certification date indicated in the project agreement
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Forfeiture of the credit amount for that tax period; credit amounts for remaining years of the eligibility period remain available
enforcement.penalty_formula: Forfeiture of the credit amount for the tax period concerned

evidence.quote: An eligible business shall forfeit the credit amount for any tax period for which the eligible business's documentation remains uncertified as of the date for certification indicated in the project agreement

enforcement.authority: New Jersey Economic Development Authority (the authority)
enforcement.triggered_by: Failure to submit the required report, failure to confirm contractor compliance, or advice that the business is neither in substantial good standing nor under a corrective action plan
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Possible forfeiture of the issuance of tax credits, pending resolution of the underlying violations or other issues
enforcement.penalty_formula: Forfeiture of the issuance of tax credits (may), pending resolution
enforcement.cure_period: Pending resolution of the underlying violations or other issues

evidence.quote: then the eligible business may forfeit the issuance of tax credits, pending resolution of the underlying violations or other issues

enforcement.triggered_by: Factual representations to the authority that are not true (certification under penalty of perjury)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Penalty of perjury (no penalty specified in this text)
enforcement.penalty_reference: penalty of perjury (not further specified in this text)

evidence.quote: are true under the penalty of perjury.
